concepts: ai is a vowel team commonly representing long a in these taught words
A vowel team uses two letters to represent a vowel sound in a taught spelling pattern.
Readers blend the consonants and read the vowel team as a unit.
Fresh examples test transfer beyond memorised responses.

definitions.definition: Two letters that work together to represent a vowel sound.
Using letter-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Applying a learned skill to a new example.

workedExamples.prompt: Read “rain”. Which letters form the vowel team?
workedExamples.solution: The letters ai work together to represent long a.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads “train” with a short vowel. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Notice the ai vowel team and reread the word with long a.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
